data¶

Data Loading and Preprocessing for Bikeshare Rebalancing¶

This module handles loading and preprocessing of real Capital Bikeshare data from October 2025 for use in the MILP rebalancing model.

Key features: - Matches trip data with station metadata using station names - Aggregates demand by user-defined time bins (1h, 2h, 4h) - Computes Euclidean distance matrix as transportation cost proxy - Sets realistic initial inventory (~50% capacity)

Functions

get_sample_data()

Return small synthetic dataset for quick testing and debugging.

load_real_data(trip_file, station_file[, ...])

Load and merge real trip and station data for the MILP model.

load_station_data(station_file)

Load station metadata (name, capacity, coordinates) from CSV.

process_trip_data_to_demands(trip_file[, ...])

Convert raw trip CSV into demand matrix D_it.
